notes.title: Version 1.0.5 has been released.
notes.content:
[list][*][p][b]Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added importance level display to documents.[/p][list][*][p]Level 3: Knowledge essential for solving puzzles.[/p][/*][*][p]Level 2: Knowledge that provides hints for puzzles.[/p][/*][*][p]Level 1: Knowledge that complements the story.[/p][/*][*][p]Level 0: Useless knowledge.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Documents with an importance level below 3 can be skipped without affecting gameplay.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced text length in documents while keeping the original content intact.[/p][/*][*][p]Replaced unclear smartphone hint images with clearer ones.[/p][/*][*][p]Coins now display a sparkle effect when they enter the player's view.[/p][/*][*][p]Brightness adjustment: The maximum value has been increased from 1.0 to 3.2.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Adjustments[/b][/p][list][*][p]The number of food items and documents no longer affects the total rank.
(Instead, "Taste Memories" and the number of sticky notes now affect the rank.)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the final quiz question being slowed down.[/p][/*][*][p]Skill enhancement timers no longer decrease while playing in-game mini-games.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Additions[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added new hints related to puzzle solving.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.4 has been released.
notes.content: [list][*][p][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed some typos in the text.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected a miscalculation in the total rank formula.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Adjustments[/b][/p][list][*][p]Reduced the hitbox size of timed bombs.[/p][/*][*][p]Extended the skill enhancement time limit from 10 minutes to 15 minutes per point.[/p][/*][*][p]Time will no longer decrease while documents are open during skill enhancement.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]New Additions[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added hints for puzzles.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.3 has been released.
notes.content: [list][*][p]Fixed a bug where the in-game mini-game could not be controlled with the mouse.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the number of old coins from 15 to 20.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed so that play time, save count, and game over count no longer affect the total rank.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted explosion sound effect volume to 0.5x.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: MOTTAINAI GHOST is now available!
notes.content: [p]Thank you for waiting![/p][p]At last, on this day—Thursday, July 31, 2025—[/p][p]MOTTAINAI GHOST is now available on Steam![/p]
